findings.title: Default strategy test skips enabling rolling-updates feature
findings.body: In operator/src/test/java/org/keycloak/operator/testsuite/integration/UpgradeTest.java createInitialDeployment() returns early when updateStrategy == null without adding Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES to FeatureSpec. The docs added in this PR state the Operator will fail while in preview unless rolling-updates is enabled, and the non-null path was updated to enable it. Consequence: the null/default parameterized cases of testImageChange and testCacheMaxCount run without the required feature and will fail or test an unsupported configuration, and the default-strategy rolling behavior is left uncovered.

findings.title: New exit-code contract not asserted
findings.body: In quarkus/tests/integration/src/test/java/org/keycloak/it/cli/dist/UpdateCommandDistTest.java testFeatureNotEnabled only checks the error text for the metadata subcommand and does not assert exit code 4 (CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED), does not cover the check subcommand which has the same gate, and testWrongVersions does not assert exit codes after CompatibilityResult.RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE was changed from 4 to 3. Consequence: the breaking exit-code renumbering and the disabled-feature path can regress silently and automation relying on exit codes 3 vs 4 is unverified.
